Container & model: `L`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 5 on 「上限提到 5，提速」, this session's chat, 2026-10-15)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/app-shell` re-export `@objectstack/spec` types, and a release with 39 breaking commits can move objectui's published surface in either direction («拿不准 ⇒ 按 yes»). The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review comes before ready.
Responsibility: n/a — a dependency bump, not a defect card
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR touches `pnpm-lock.yaml` or a workspace `package.json` (open PRs read in this act: dependabot objectui#11845 and #11844 on `next`, and the release PR objectui#11600). Held cards objectui#12406, #12486, #12476 and #12285 serialise behind this PR unless a forced red folds them in, as the card's table says.
